idea: On days when the market’s implied overnight move (impl) is larger than the observed overnight range (k_on_range), are we more likely to see NQ trade above the overnight high (y_took_overnight_high) during the NY session?

spec.explain: Inspired by research on how option‑priced expected moves (impl) and event premiums influence breakout probabilities, this asks whether a stronger implied move relative to the actual overnight range signals a higher chance of breaking the overnight high.
